description: This file defines an interface 'ISiloStatusListener' within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. The interface specifies a method for receiving notifications about silo status changes, intended for components that need to be aware of silo status updates within the Orleans distributed runtime.

classes.name: ISiloStatusListener
classes.description: Interface for types which listen to silo status change notifications.

methods.name: SiloStatusChangeNotification
methods.description: Method to handle notifications about changes in silo status.
